result.summary: Found 1 major issue: an untranslated localization key is displayed as a section heading. The rest of the page appears visually consistent.

issues.description: The section title 'home_feed.popular_title' shows a raw localization/translation key instead of the intended text (e.g., 'Popular near you').
issues.suggestion: Fix the missing translation string in the localization files so the key resolves to proper user-facing text.
